title: Text measured by CSS for signs, labels and particles
blurb: A neon sign, book spines and a ticker sized by text-fit and text-box-trim, and a real input in the canvas whose characters grow in, fly to the sign and break apart when deleted.
question: Can CSS do the text measuring for a canvas: fit and trim a label to a box, and report the box of each character in an input?
result: Yes in Chromium 157. text-fit and text-box-trim size the drawn element, and input.createValueRange() gives a box per character that matches the drawn ink.
